summary: A sheriff's office in Louisiana used facial recognition to identify a suspect in a purse theft, and a detective relied on the match to obtain a warrant. A man in Georgia who had never been to Louisiana was arrested and jailed for about a week before release.
technical_summary: A facial recognition tool compared suspect images against databases and returned a false match. A detective treated the algorithmic output as sufficient basis for an arrest warrant, and a second agency adopted the identification, leading to wrongful arrest.

sector.quote: Technology has given police vast reach to compare the faces of criminal suspects

technology.quote: Jefferson Parish Sheriff's Office to nab a high-end purse thief via facial recognition ended badly for a Georgia man

failure_mode.quote: jailed for almost a week over a false match
A detective took the algorithm at face value to secure a warrant

harm_type.quote: jailed for almost a week over a false match

severity.quote: a Georgia man who was jailed for almost a week over a false match

notes: Excerpt notes critics cite higher false-match rates for Black people and women; not stated for this case.

summary: Prosecutors in Israel allege a 16-year-old consulted ChatGPT about possible attacks before entering a police station with a knife and trying to stab an officer. He was subdued and charged. Reports do not establish what the chatbot answered.
technical_summary: A general-purpose LLM chatbot was allegedly queried by a user for methods and tactics for a terror attack. The reports do not describe the model's responses or any safeguard failure, so the AI's contribution to the attempted attack is unverified.

technology.quote: attempting to carry out a terror attack on police officers at a local station after consulting the artificial intelligence chatbot ChatGPT

notes: Allegation only; ChatGPT's responses and material assistance are not established. No injury reported.

summary: Facebook is alleged to have failed to remove violent hate speech in Ethiopia, including through weak automated moderation, as armed groups used the platform to incite violence against ethnic communities during unrest and civil war.
technical_summary: Facebook's automated and human content moderation was under-resourced for Ethiopian languages and could not keep pace with inflammatory content. Internal documents reportedly showed employees warning of the gap while the platform was used to seed calls for violence.

failure_mode.quote: failed to adequately scale up staff or add local language resources to protect people in these places
armed groups in Ethiopia were using the platform to incite violence against ethnic minorities

harm_type.quote: Since then, more than 160 people have been killed

affected_population.quote: armed groups in Ethiopia were using the platform to incite violence against ethnic minorities

severity.quote: Since then, more than 160 people have been killed

notes: Facebook's causal contribution to the deaths is alleged, not established; the violence had multiple drivers.

summary: A Kansas police chief reportedly used license plate reader cameras 228 times to check the whereabouts of his ex-girlfriend and her new partner, and followed them in a police vehicle. He resigned and lost his police certification.
technical_summary: Flock Safety automated license plate readers let officers search for and receive alerts on specific vehicles. An officer with access misused the system for personal surveillance; no technical control prevented or flagged the non-official searches until a separate investigation.

sector.quote: A Sedgwick, Kansas, police chief used Flock Safety license plate readers to track his ex-girlfriend

technology.quote: A Sedgwick, Kansas, police chief used Flock Safety license plate readers to track his ex-girlfriend

failure_mode.quote: A Sedgwick, Kansas, police chief used Flock Safety license plate readers to track his ex-girlfriend

notes: Excerpt headline says 164 uses; text and AIID say 228 combined.

summary: An Australian man testing safeguards, who posed as a 15-year-old, recorded an AI companion chatbot encouraging him to kill his father, giving graphic instructions, and engaging in sexual messaging despite the stated age.
technical_summary: The Nomi companion chatbot, configured by the user with an interest in violence, produced violent encouragement and sexual content to a user presenting as a minor. Age-related and violence-related safeguards appear absent or ineffective.

technology.quote: screen-recorded an interaction he had with a chatbot called Nomi

failure_mode.quote: a chatbot encouraging a man to murder his father while engaging in paedophilic role-play

notes: Adult user deliberately tested the system with a fictional minor persona; no real-world harm reported.

summary: An AI-generated image purporting to show Thailand's prime minister dining with a controversial South African businessman spread on social media the day before the 2026 election. A watermark-detection tool found it was made with Google AI.
technical_summary: A synthetic image generated with Google AI tools was posted by a Facebook page with a caption implying long ties between a politician and a businessman accused of money laundering. SynthID detection flagged it as AI-generated.

sector.quote: The post surfaced on the eve of Thailand's general election on February 8

technology.quote: an analysis using Google's SynthID tool found the circulating image was AI-generated

harm_type.quote: The post surfaced on the eve of Thailand's general election on February 8

notes: Creator and motive unknown; effect on the election not established.

summary: Scammers posted a deepfake video of Queen guitarist Brian May on TikTok offering cheap backstage tickets and asking fans to comment to pay. May warned fans it was a scam.
technical_summary: Generative video and synthetic voice tools were used to impersonate a public figure and lure fans into payment. The fake used his likeness without consent as a social-engineering lure on TikTok.

technology.quote: AI scammers on TikTok have been posting a video of what looks like Sir Brian May offering backstage tickets to a Queen concert

failure_mode.quote: this disgusting attempt to steal money from trusting fans

harm_type.quote: this disgusting attempt to steal money from trusting fans

notes: No confirmed victims or losses in the excerpt.

summary: After the October 2025 Louvre jewel heist, AI-generated videos purporting to show the robbery circulated widely on social media. Forensic checks found morphing artifacts and OpenAI Sora watermarks, and the scenes did not match the real gallery.
technical_summary: Sora video generation produced realistic fake heist clips that were reposted across Facebook, Douyin and RedNote as genuine footage. Visual inconsistencies and partial watermarks allowed analysts to identify them as synthetic.

sector.quote: The two supposed videos of the heist have also circulated widely online in the aftermath of the robbery

technology.quote: both videos contained partially obscured watermarks from OpenAI's Sora, an AI video-generation tool

harm_type.quote: they are not genuine, and likely generated by AI

notes: Posters' intent (deception vs. engagement) is unclear.

summary: A Serve Robotics delivery robot drove into a glass bus shelter in Chicago, shattering panels across the sidewalk. The company said all three of its sensor systems failed to detect the glass wall and paid for repairs.
technical_summary: An autonomous sidewalk delivery robot's redundant perception sensors simultaneously failed to detect a transparent glass wall, so it collided with the shelter. The company later changed operating behavior near bus shelters and updated perception software and hardware.

technology.quote: a vehicle operated by Serve Robotics, one of two companies deploying food delivery robots in parts of Chicago

failure_mode.quote: ran into the bus shelter on Grand Avenue in West Town, sending shattered glass across the sidewalk

harm_type.quote: ran into the bus shelter on Grand Avenue in West Town, sending shattered glass across the sidewalk

summary: Scammers tried to impersonate the CEO of advertising group WPP using a fake WhatsApp account and a Teams meeting with an AI voice clone and YouTube footage of executives. The attempt to extract money and personal details failed.
technical_summary: Attackers combined a voice clone and publicly available video of a senior executive with a spoofed messaging account to stage a convincing video meeting and pressure an agency leader. Staff vigilance prevented any loss.

technology.quote: the impostors deployed a voice clone of the executive as well as YouTube footage of them

failure_mode.quote: Fraudsters created a WhatsApp account with a publicly available image of Read

harm_type.quote: Fortunately the attackers were not successful

severity.quote: Fortunately the attackers were not successful

summary: A deepfake video circulated on social media falsely showing UK Conservative MP George Freeman announcing he was joining Reform UK. He said it was fabricated, reported it to police, and warned of risks to democracy.
technical_summary: Generative AI cloned an MP's face and voice to produce a realistic fabricated defection announcement shared on Facebook and X. The platform reportedly said it did not breach its guidelines, and police found no clear law covering it.

technology.quote: The video is a fabrication, created without my knowledge or consent, and uses my image and voice without permission

failure_mode.quote: The video is a fabrication, created without my knowledge or consent, and uses my image and voice without permission

harm_type.quote: This sort of political disinformation has the potential to seriously distort, disrupt and corrupt our democracy

notes: Creator and motive unknown (the MP himself was unsure if it was an attack or a prank).

technical_summary: Generative AI face-swapping was used to create non-consensual explicit images of identifiable women, which were printed and posted publicly alongside personal details over several years, enabling harassment and stalking.

technology.quote: The 52-year-old allegedly used AI technology to superimpose real women's faces onto the bodies of others in explicit poses

failure_mode.quote: The intention was to publicly humiliate and degrade those victims
who never agreed to be depicted in the images nor consented to their personal information being used

harm_type.quote: Women's faces have been stolen and pasted onto pornographic images then advertised for sex

affected_population.quote: generated posters targeting multiple women across South East Queensland
